runner_state: optimizers_gpu state_dict, param_groups and mapping by parameter name
optimizers_cpu state_dict, param_groups and mapping by parameter name
strategy_state all keys plus strategy dataclass config
config and scene scale, source/extension/environment identities
rng: all owned Torch CUDA generator states (owner only during authorized GPU run)
recorded original DataLoader initial base_seed RNG state
each epoch full RandomSampler permutation plus delivered sample/batch cursor

loader.qualified_deterministic_requirement: patch_size=None and unchanged source/input transforms; random background and any other training random state separately preserved
loader.image_id_semantics: Dataset item index, not parser index; Dataset.indices mapping must be hashed
loader.prologue_consumption: first camera rendered at step0; second camera preloaded for step1; consumer cursor includes both
loader.resume_prefetch: reconstruct dispatched-but-unconsumed deterministic samples from recorded permutation and delivered cursor; no new permutation
loader.base_seed: new loader draw isolated via private generator initialized from original initial base_seed RNG state; explicit sampler retains main-global RNG at future epochs
loader.worker_rng_scope: NOT_CAPTURED_DETERMINISTIC_GETITEM_REQUIRED; stochastic Dataset requires a different qualified design

execution_environment: omp_set_num_threads(64) occurs in six operations; OMP_THREAD_LIMIT/affinity cap remains necessary
FTZ/DAZ flags are per executing thread and must be consistent
pybind calls release GIL; pause only after worker join and completed CPU calls
cpp.update_ids_order: ascending partitions concatenated by omp thread index; validate real row identity and count
cpp.counter: int8 per Gaussian; ordinary steps increment all N and reset selected U; deferred lookup expects 0..15; never zero on ordinary checkpoint

pending_semantics.after_prepared: CPU .grad contains just-completed camera gradients not yet committed; already-forwarded GPU CPU-parameter leaves predict next step from those gradients
pending_semantics.restore: load actual prepared leaf values; do not recompute from CPU weights or rerun prologue
pending_semantics.closure: GPU steps and CPU credit can differ by one; ledger must track completed forward/backward, CPU applied gradient, per-optimizer steps, counter ages, prepared next camera
pending_semantics.terminal: original last configured max_steps-1 forces is_densify=True and all-N deferred update; continuing from an artificial intermediate drain changes trajectory. Preserve undrained checkpoint; report separate explicit terminal drain only.

cpu_tests.peak_scope: getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN), not sum or Goal-wide peak
cpu_tests.warning: 4 original workers under 2 helper-affinity CPUs; expected suggested-worker warning retained; training cpuset qualification is owner responsibility

not_yet_proven: real GPU full-state save/load and exact next camera/grad/optimizer equality
independent reloaded continuous-vs-restored trajectory and frozen numerical threshold
actual pending-gradient final drain equivalence and end-to-end timing
real extension runtime hash and FTZ/OMP runtime settings
full dataset byte identity and absence of stochastic transforms in actual selected config
